messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I’m having trouble sending MMS messages with my messaging app. It’s been a few hours now while I’m here in France. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
I can help you with that! To get started, I’ll need to verify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth?
Sure! My phone number is 555-123-2002, and my full name is John Smith. Let me know if you need any other details.

Could you confirm the phone number (ending digits) or let me know which line you’re using for MMS?
I’m currently using the line ending in 2002—the same number I mentioned earlier (555-123-2002)—for messaging and for trying to send MMS.

Please try sending an MMS again. If it still doesn’t work, let me know and we can continue troubleshooting!
(guides the customer through a device action)
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
I just tried, but I’m still unable to send MMS messages. What should I try next?

Thank you for checking. Let’s continue troubleshooting. Please follow these steps on your phone:

1. Make sure mobile data is turned ON (not just Wi-Fi).
2. Check that Airplane Mode is OFF.
3. Try turning your phone off and back on (reboot).

If you’ve already done these, let me know. Otherwise, please try them and tell me if you see any changes. If the issue persists, I’ll guide you through more detailed checks.
(guides the customer through a device action)

I checked my phone, and mobile data is ON, Airplane Mode is OFF, and Wi-Fi is turned off. My cellular connection is active, but it seems like I only have a poor 2G signal right now. I haven’t rebooted my phone yet—would you like me to try that next, or is there anything else I should check given the 2G connection?

Thank you for the update. MMS typically requires at least a 3G connection—2G is usually not sufficient for sending or receiving MMS.

Please check your phone’s network mode settings and make sure it is set to prefer 4G or 5G networks (not limited to 2G/3G). If you know how to do this, please set your network mode to “4G/5G preferred.” If you’re not sure how, let me know your device model and I can guide you.

After updating the network mode, please reboot your phone to help it connect to a better network. Then try sending an MMS again and let me know the result.

Your messaging app can send MMS messages.
I updated the network mode to 4G/5G preferred and restarted my phone. Now I have an excellent 5G signal, and I’m able to send MMS messages again! Thank you for your help—this fixed the issue.

I’m glad to hear that updating your network mode and rebooting your phone resolved the MMS issue! If you have any more questions or need further assistance while you’re abroad, feel free to ask. Safe travels and have a great day!
Thank you so much for your help! I appreciate the quick assistance. Have a great day! ###STOP###
